scope: Initial BUY signal historical provenance for execution-clock sizing research

v7SignalDeliveryState.storageShape: single mutable snapshot_json per signal-state key

signalStateKvMirror.role: mirror of current signal state; not immutable signal history

reconstructionFalsification.shortcut: lastEntrySignalBarTime + historical 15m candle can reconstruct exact BUY trigger price
reconstructionFalsification.reason: lastEntrySignalBarTime is the formal 15m bar time, while buildPushPayload.currentPrice comes from the contemporaneous quote; the quote can differ from the completed 15m close and the successful payload is not durably retained.

safeInterpretation.currentState: May support dedupe/episode existence and recent operational debugging.
safeInterpretation.historicalTriggerPrice: UNKNOWN unless an exact durable payload/event record is available.
safeInterpretation.fillEvidence: Always separate; signal price is not a fill.
